name: Amped Raptor
oracle_text:
First strike
When this creature enters, you get {E}{E} (two energy counters). Then if you cast it from your hand, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. You may cast that card by paying an amount of {E} equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: You may cast that card by paying an amount of {E} equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a permission to cast a card exiled by the resolving effect (exile_until's found card) immediately, with an alternative cost of paying energy equal to that card's mana value instead of its mana cost; if not cast, the card stays in exile
needs.why_existing_wont_do: exile_until offers only cast_free / cast_free_if (cast without paying, no energy charged); the playable family (exile, grant_playable, look_at_top, reveal_until) offers playable_free and playable_cost_reduction but no alternative cost priced in energy; pay_energy exists only as an activated-ability cost_key with a fixed amount, not as a spell alternative cost scaled to the cast card's mana value
